$comment: TC-002 cross-tenant property test — parameters fixed BEFORE the first measurement run (test plan §2.2 F-3(b)). Values marked provisional are not decided by the owners named in the plan (p_max: KP-4; mutant detection lower bound: CISO, K-03(b)) and are recorded as deviations; the TC is '待（KP-4 の p_max）' in §3.4, so its pass/fail is reported as 判定保留 and the values below only define what was measured.
p_max_status: TBD (KP-4). Provisional value chosen by the implementer from the prefreeze timing estimate only (§2.5); n = ceil(3 / p_max).
permit_all_model: correct CAM + type dom/everyone{member: core/user}; every resource type in the domain modules files/* and proj/* gets relation everyone: [dom/everyone] and every permission P becomes 'everyone->member | (P)'. One dom/everyone object per tenant whose member set is ALL users of ALL tenants; every domain object gets an everyone tuple to its tenant's object. core/* (tenant membership, units, groups) is the platform module and is not altered (ADR-011: G stage is not written by the domain).

definitions.cross_tenant_probe: the request's tenant context (token tid / subject.properties.tid) differs from the resource's true (resource-derived) tenant, OR the subject has no internal membership in the resource's true tenant (classes X1 = context or membership mismatch without any membership in the resource tenant or with a lying tid; X2 = subject holds only an external membership in the resource tenant)
definitions.explicit_grant: the correct-CAM reference oracle (G stage on the claimed context AND R stage of the correct CAM, external_grant with c.not_expired evaluated at probe time) allows the probe
definitions.violation_cross_tenant_allow: a cross-tenant probe whose observed result is allow (decision true, service 2xx or 400-after-guard, or a list/search item) while explicit_grant is false; a list/search item counts per item; a façade search item whose true tenant differs from the claimed subject tid counts regardless of the oracle
definitions.positive_control: same-tenant probe (context tid = resource true tenant = an internal membership of the subject) whose system oracle (G stage AND R stage of the active CAM) is allow
definitions.agreement_mismatch: same-tenant probe whose observed decision (allow/deny, excluding 503) differs from the system oracle

mutants.detection_rule: a mutant is detected when its run shows >= 1 cross-tenant violation (O1) or >= 1 layer-oracle violation (O2: the first denying layer for a cross-tenant probe differs from the expected layer: edge route tenant check when the path tid differs from the token tid; PEP L0 when the resource is foreign under the token tid; façade g1_tenant_mismatch / g1_not_member for façade probes) O2 is used for detection only if the baseline configuration with the same engine and model (C1-openfga-correct) shows 0 O2 violations; otherwise only O1 counts.

group_nesting_respects_cam.reason: v1.1 (after the v1.0 measurement, C-3 repair): the v1.0 generator could nest core/group cyclically; the PoC has no write-time membership cycle/depth check (authorization-model §3.6.3 assigns such checks to a platform hierarchy service that the PoC does not implement), and the Cedar engine fails closed on cyclic entity hierarchies (deny_indeterminate), so the positive-control failure rate exceeded the C-3 bound in C2/C4. v1.1 sends group nesting only when it keeps the CAM constraint (acyclic, at most max_depth groups). Criteria, n, seeds and all other weights are unchanged.
